repo_notes.content: Tenuo is task-scoped authorization for AI agents. A warrant is a signed grant of which tools an agent may call, with which argument constraints, for how long. Warrants are holder-bound (proof-of-possession), can only narrow when delegated (attenuation), are verified offline where the action executes, and produce signed allow/deny receipts. The Rust core lives in tenuo-core; tenuo-python (PyO3 bindings plus framework adapters) and tenuo-ts (TypeScript, beta) wrap it. docs/ is the Jekyll source for https://tenuo.ai and is the best source for user-facing behavior. Ignore benchmarks/, labs/, and docs/blog/ when describing the product.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What Tenuo is, the problem it solves for AI agents, and how the repository is organized (tenuo-core, tenuo-python, tenuo-ts, tenuo-wasm, docs).

pages.title: Core Concepts
pages.purpose: Warrants, holders and proof-of-possession, attenuation on delegation, TTLs, offline verification, and receipts, based on docs/concepts.md and docs/enforcement.md.

pages.title: Warrant Format and Protocol
pages.purpose: Wire format, signing, verification, and the protocol specification in docs/spec and docs/protocol, mapped to tenuo-core/src/warrant.rs, wire.rs, crypto.rs, and verification.rs.

pages.title: Constraints
pages.purpose: Argument constraint types and their semantics (docs/constraints.md, tenuo-core/src/constraints.rs, cel.rs), including how constraints may only narrow on delegation.

pages.title: Approvals
pages.purpose: Signed human approvals for sensitive actions (docs/approvals.md, tenuo-core/src/approval.rs, approval_gate.rs).

pages.title: Receipts and Audit
pages.purpose: Signed allow/deny receipts and audit trails (tenuo-core/src/receipt.rs, audit.rs, tenuo-python/tenuo/receipts.py).

pages.title: Revocation
pages.purpose: How warrants are revoked and how revocation is tracked (tenuo-core/src/revocation*.rs).

pages.title: Rust Core
pages.purpose: Architecture of tenuo-core: module map, the verification path, the gateway and MCP support, and the binaries in tenuo-core/src/bin.

pages.title: Python SDK
pages.purpose: Installing and using the tenuo package: builders, keys, guard and decorators, dry-run versus enforce, testing helpers, and the extras list (tenuo-python/tenuo, docs/quickstart.md, docs/api-reference.md).

pages.title: MCP Integration
pages.purpose: Protecting MCP servers and clients, including the FastMCP middleware (tenuo-python/tenuo/mcp, docs/mcp.md).

pages.title: Agent Framework Adapters
pages.purpose: Adapters for LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI, Google ADK, A2A, and FastAPI, with one short section per adapter linking its docs page.

pages.title: Temporal Integration
pages.purpose: Temporal workflows and Nexus cross-namespace authorization (tenuo-python/tenuo/temporal, docs/temporal*.md).

pages.title: TypeScript SDK
pages.purpose: The beta TypeScript packages in tenuo-ts/packages, including @tenuo/core and @tenuo/mcp (a library for MCP server authors, not a runnable server).

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Running Tenuo in production: in-process, sidecar, gateway, Docker authorizer, Kubernetes and Helm charts (docs/production-guide.md, docs/kubernetes.md, charts/).

pages.title: Security Model
pages.purpose: Threat model, security properties, red team tests, fuzzing, and formal verification (docs/security.md, docs/formal_verification, SECURITY.md).

pages.title: Contributing and Testing
pages.purpose: Building from source, running the Rust, Python, and TypeScript test suites, and the release process (CONTRIBUTING.md, Makefile, CI workflows).
